descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P2 · extra (accessibility, performance, prototype detail) · ours: accessibility (axe, accessible names).

Suggestion A1 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was S2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Buttons, inputs and dropdowns have no accessible name (Nursing Home +, settings, back, close X, task done/delete, medication status dropdown); also some focus jumps to the top and small tap targets

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S22 Encounter tab, full-screen notepad and Post-Round note pass axe (WCAG 2 A/AA), both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Both entry paths reach the same place: 'Begin Encounter' on the Pre-Round tab and the Encounter tab open the same encounter view (dictation box, Save & Extract, Generate). (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Generate AI Note moves the physician to Post-Round with the generated note there. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T2 The encounter notepad renders full-size, matching Vikram's app. (TFA-92592 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual-lane fixture; screens hospital-chart-encounter and nh-chart-encounter exist, Post-Round with a note and the full-screen notepad do not

When The visual lane runs axe-core on the Encounter tab, the notepad opened full screen, and Post-Round with a generated note, in both modes

Then No serious or critical violations. Dictate, Save & Extract, Generate and the note-format picker have accessible names; the notepad textarea has a label; the generated note is exposed as a named document

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core results (visual-checks.ts): zero serious or critical; other findings go to a human

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from broken to failed.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-92592 ready for qa

A screen-reader user hears an unnamed button for the Nursing Home back arrow on the Encounter tab, the full-screen notepad and Post-Round, and Copy to EMR and Mark Visit Complete fail colour contrast.

Evidence: Allure d5c2f5e6, visual lane: 24 checks passed, 18 failed. axe button-name (critical) on the NH back button. Contrast: Copy to EMR 3.66:1, Mark Visit Complete 3.21:1, plus the disabled format chip. Not in dev report §5, which lists other dialogs. The gate TFA-92592 is at ready for pr, but these items are outside that PR.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
